headline: Guns of Eschaton launches December 8
title: Guns of Eschaton | Western Soulslike FPS Dec 8 | Gaming News
video_script: Guns of Eschaton launches on December eighth, twenty twenty six for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. It is a first person soulslike shooter set in an occult, apocalyptic nineteenth century America, with online co-op. The publisher is 4Divinity and the developer is Eschatology Entertainment. The date was revealed on October fifteenth. Solo or co-op? Comment below!
description: Guns of Eschaton launches December 8, 2026 on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Sources: Gematsu, VGChartz, Xbox Store.
joke: In a soulslike, dying is just the game saying hello again.
